MORNING COFFEE
by Noa Levi

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

DANA
Good morning. I called you three times.

JOE
I know. My phone was on silent.

DANA
(puts down the cup) On silent? I waited all night.

MIKE
You are both exaggerating. Sit down.

JOE
I am not hungry. I only came to explain.

DANA
Then explain. I am listening.

MIKE
(whispering) She is not really listening.

DANA
Mike!

JOE
Okay, okay. I should have called.

MIKE
Finally, someone says it out loud.
